name: Erosmash!
source:
Jisaburou belongs to the IT club. One day, Sakurako, the boss of the club, calls up several club members, and they try black magic. While doing it, he makes a mistake, and a monster suddenly appears in front of them. According to the monster, he needs more power to return to his world. And to generate the power, Jisaburou and the girls must have sex...

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
十三郎隶属于IT社。某天，社团社长樱子召集了几位社团成员，尝试黑魔法。在施法过程中，他犯了一个错误，一只怪物突然出现在他们面前。据怪物说，他需要更多力量才能回到自己的世界。而要产生这股力量，十三郎和女孩们必须做爱……

[引自Himeya Shop]
